subject: extracting species occurrence data from stochastic maps

messages.author: d3c9ac62d374695a
messages.subject: extracting species occurrence data from stochastic maps
parts:
Hello,

I am hoping to use stochastic maps from BioGeoBEARS to create a list of sympatric taxa (i.e., a list that updates at every cladogenetic/anagenetic event on the tree and indicates which lineages exist in which regions) from the root to the tip of a phylogeny.

I write because I have two questions before diving into writing the code:

(1) Am I correct to start by looking in the cladogenetic/anagenetic event tables, or are there other objects produced by stochastic mapping or scripts that would be a better place to start?

(2) If the event tables are the way to go, for cladogenetic events, am I correct to assume that the "left_desc_nodes" and "right_desc_nodes" refer to the left and right of the comma after the arrow in the column "clado_event_txt"?

Thanks in advance!

Jonathan Drury
